proof_scope: ask entrypoints, browser-window reclamation, output pruning, blocker-ledger honesty gates, and the MVP fail-now proof gate, exercised against real browser/filesystem state and a real captured model proposal

claims.proves: the Ask sanity entrypoint and Surf browser-provider preflight recovery classification meet explicit local expectations
claims.does_not_prove: browser provider semantic correctness, live WebGPT review completion, or full Ask orchestration readiness

cases.name: help-does-not-contradict-dispatch
cases.proves: Every handler shortcut --help advertises really routes to tau-dag (probed behaviorally, not by text match), --help makes no blanket 'removed from /ask' claim about a command it still advertises, and the webgpt shortcut genuinely compiles to a Tau DAG.

cases.name: help-contradiction-is-actually-detected
command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/ask && cp run.sh /tmp/ask-run-sh.bak && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('run.sh').read()
s=s.replace("  Use './run.sh webgpt <question>'", "  WebGPT has been removed from /ask. Use $surf webgpt.submit\n  Use './run.sh webgpt <question>'")
open('run.sh','w').write(s)
EOF
uv run python scripts/check_help_dispatch_consistency.py --skip-compile; rc=$?; cp /tmp/ask-run-sh.bak run.sh; rm -f /tmp/ask-run-sh.bak; test $rc -eq 1
cases.proves: The gate is not vacuous: reintroducing the real 2026-08-13 contradiction ('WebGPT has been removed from /ask' beside the advertised webgpt shortcut) makes it FAIL, and run.sh is restored afterward.

cases.name: pruner-never-deletes-on-a-dry-run
command: cd .. && before=$(find /mnt/storage12tb/skills/ask/outputs -maxdepth 2 -type d | wc -l) && ./run.sh prune-outputs >/dev/null 2>&1; after=$(find /mnt/storage12tb/skills/ask/outputs -maxdepth 2 -type d | wc -l); test "$before" = "$after" && echo DRY_RUN_DELETED_NOTHING

cases.name: clearing-a-blocker-without-live-proof-is-refused
command: cd .. && ./run.sh drift clear t f --live-proof '' 2>&1 || true

cases.name: unblock-refuses-a-single-candidate
command: cd .. && L=$(mktemp) && ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER=$L uv run --project . python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from ask import blocker_ledger as b;b.record(target='evalt',failure_code='evalf')" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER=$L ./run.sh unblock --target evalt --failure-code evalf --handler webgpt --no-research --execute 2>&1 || true

cases.name: brave-search-grounding-is-live
command: cd .. && ./run.sh unblock --target skills/ask --failure-code surf_browser_lock_timeout --json 2>/dev/null | head -c 4000 || true

cases.name: model-provenance-on-a-real-receipt-is-unconfirmed
command: cd .. && uv run --project . python -c "import sys,json,pathlib;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from ask import model_provenance as m;p=sorted(pathlib.Path('/mnt/storage12tb/skills/ask/outputs').rglob('*response*.meta.json'),key=lambda x:x.stat().st_mtime,reverse=True)[0];b=m.from_submit_meta(json.loads(p.read_text()),handler='webgpt');print(b['provenance_status']);assert b['reasoning_proven'] is False"

cases.name: a-torn-ledger-append-loses-one-entry-not-the-file
command: cd .. && L=$(mktemp) && ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER=$L uv run --project . python -c "import sys,os;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from ask import blocker_ledger as b;b.record(target='t',failure_code='f1');open(os.environ['ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER'],'a').write('{\"key\": \"tor');b.record(target='t',failure_code='f2');ks={e['failure_code'] for e in b.load()};print(sorted(ks));assert ks=={'f1','f2'}, ks"

cases.name: the-lane-failure-code-beats-the-generic-status
command: cd .. && export RD=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p $RD/node-artifacts/handler-webgpt && echo '{"failure_code":"browser_submit_not_accepted"}' > $RD/node-artifacts/handler-webgpt/node-receipt.json && export ASK_BLOCKER_LEDGER=$(mktemp) && uv run --project . python -c "import sys,os;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from ask import blocker_ledger as b;e=b.record_from_execution({'status':'NEEDS_ATTENTION','ok':False},target='t',run_dir=os.environ['RD']);print(e['failure_code'])"

cases.name: a-tracked-path-can-never-be-declared-synthetic
command:
cd .. && uv run --project . python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from ask.writer_isolation import verify_setup_hook_result,SetupHookError
from contextlib import suppress
try:
 verify_setup_hook_result({'syntheticPaths':['src/app.py']},tracked_paths=['src/app.py'])
 raise SystemExit('ACCEPTED_A_TRACKED_PATH')
except SetupHookError as e:
 print('REFUSED:',e)"

cases.name: a-compound-proposal-is-refused
command: cd .. && uv run --project . python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');from ask import mvp_unblock as m;f=m.parse_candidate(open('fixtures/live-webgpt-proposal.md').read());f['WHY_THIS_UNBLOCKS']+=' and also refactor the module.';p=m.validate_singular(f);print(p);assert any('compound' in x for x in p)"
